properties.name: manhattan_1852
properties.map: Map of the City of New-York extending northward to Fiftieth St., surveyed and drawn by John F. Harrison, C.E. — published by M. Dripps, New York (first published 1852)
properties.georeferencing: NYPL Map Warper control points (NYC Space/Time Directory dump mapwarper.objects.ndjson, map 14758), thin-plate spline; residual = cross-validated RMS over 36 points
properties.note: The map draws every building south of 50th St. Built-up = where the drawn buildings (hatched footprints) make the sheet darker than its local paper tone (threshold calibrated on fully built and on empty parts of the sheet: fully built blocks come out 88-94 % covered, farmland under 8 %), closed across streets, yards and squares under 0.6 ha filled. NYPL's copy is varnished and dark, so thinly built blocks at the edge can be missed or over-read by a block. The Map Warper record of this copy is dated 1857; which state of the plate it is was not checked (the map was first issued in 1852). North of 50th St the map shows nothing.
properties.method: built blocks classified by tone on the warped map (tools/classify.py, parameters in tools/classify_runs.py), clipped to a hand-drawn envelope

properties.note: The map draws every building south of 50th St. Built-up = where the drawn buildings (hatched footprints) make the sheet darker than its local paper tone (threshold calibrated on fully built and on empty parts of the sheet: fully built blocks come out 88-94 % covered, farmland under 8 %), closed across streets, yards and squares under 0.6 ha filled. NYPL's copy is varnished and dark, so thinly built blocks at the edge can be missed or over-read by a block. The Map Warper record of this copy is dated 1857; which state of the plate it is was not checked (the map was first issued in 1852). North of 50th St the map shows nothing.
properties.method: built blocks classified by tone on the warped map (tools/classify.py, parameters in tools/classify_runs.py), clipped to a hand-drawn envelope
